fields.description: Block title the row came from in the development sheet, e.g. HIT-03 ( CORE PRINTS ). Empty for buyer sheets that are a single flat table, such as SHEIN.
fields.label: Collection

fields.description: Serial number as it appeared in the source sheet. Traceability only - it restarts at 1 in every block, so it is never an identifier.
fields.label: S.No.

fields.description: Origin cell in the source workbook, e.g. SHEIN!A2. Lets a re-import recognise a row it has already loaded.
fields.label: Source Ref

fields.description: Deliberately not mandatory: the SHEIN sheet leaves its BRAND column empty on every row because the brand is implied by the tab.
fields.label: Brand

fields.description: Derived from Development Date on save when left blank. Legacy sheets carry only a month name and no year.
fields.label: Month
fields.options:
JANUARY
FEBRUARY
MARCH
APRIL
MAY
JUNE
JULY
AUGUST
SEPTEMBER
OCTOBER
NOVEMBER
DECEMBER

fields.description: Deliberately not mandatory: SHEIN fills a style name on only 34 of its 74 rows - the rest are identified by image and brick alone.
fields.label: Style Name

fields.description: Merchandising bucket as used by the buyer, e.g. Knit Tops, Sleepset, Tanks, Bottom.
fields.label: Brick

fields.description: The buyer's full brick hierarchy when they restate it in their remarks, e.g. Tops > Knit Top > Tops.
fields.label: Buyer Brick Path

fields.description: Attach an image; it is offloaded to S3 on save and this field then holds the servable S3 URL.
fields.label: Actual Image

fields.description: Attach an image; it is offloaded to S3 on save and this field then holds the servable S3 URL.
fields.label: Artwork / CAD / Flat Sketch

fields.description: Data, not Int - batch numbers are mostly numeric but alphanumerics such as 20RR337217 occur.
fields.label: Batch No.

fields.description: Set when the source sheet flagged the GSM as unconfirmed, e.g. 300 ( Need to check Gsm ).
fields.label: GSM To Be Verified

fields.description: Divisor used to derive Tentative FOB from MRP. The source sheet uses 2.2 on 37 of its 38 priced rows.
fields.label: FOB Factor

fields.description: Auto-filled as MRP / FOB Factor on save when left blank; set it explicitly to override.
fields.label: Tentative FOB

fields.description: From the APPROVED DESIGN column of the legacy sheets. The SHEIN sheet has no equivalent, so its rows stay Pending.
fields.label: Design Status

fields.description: Buyer feedback prose - fabric, colour and costing instructions.
